description: This file defines the AddressTemplate class, which extends the LayoutTemplate class and provides specific implementations related to address layout using tokens and support instances in the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: AddressTemplate
classes.description: A class that extends LayoutTemplate to specify address layout tokens and support within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: AddressTemplate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the template with a specified string.

methods.name: getLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the token representing the address in the layout.

methods.name: getNonLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the token representing a non-address element in the layout.

methods.name: getLayoutSupportInstance
methods.description: Provides an instance of layout support specific to addresses.

methods.name: getCodeName
methods.description: Returns the code name for this template, defaulting to 'default' when not set.
